text: {"lessons":["Taking partial profits in Stock B, D, and E felt rewarding, but I should size sales by my portfolio plan rather than by the satisfaction of locking in a gain.","My account value rose overall, yet that does not prove my trades caused the gains or predict what comes next; I should not use recent price moves as forecasts.","Buying across all five stocks increased diversification, and I should keep reviewing position sizes and cash so no single holding or emotional reaction drives my decisions."]}
